checkpoint.summary: Master inspection completed. Security design: atomic non-force lease CAS; untrusted issue content is data; QA records bind exact PR head/base and historical QA lease; trusted-base workflow never executes PR code with a write token; merge and deletion require fresh native evidence. Projects/auto-merge/protection writes are denied. Use Issue labels, native dependencies, least-privilege Actions and documented best-effort scheduling.
